name: Electromagnetic Fields and Waves Laboratory
description: This lab is structured to provide both experimental and simulation-based exposure to electromagnetics, with the first half focused on hands-on experiments and the second half on computational tools. Experimental topics include comparison of wavelength inside and outside a rectangular waveguide, standing wave and VSWR measurement, impedance determination, dispersion in optical links, and fabrication and testing of a patch antenna to study its radiation pattern. The lab further introduces the analysis of frequency selective surfaces (FSS) and concludes with computational electromagnetics modules, giving students a broader understanding of waveguides, transmission lines, antennas, and related structures.
